title: "Strategy Mechanics"

## VRP cluster — 5-instrument iron condor

### Universe

| Ticker | Class | Section 1256 | Strike grid (pts) | Wing width (pts) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| SPX | Cash index | Yes (60/40) | 5 | 5 |
| RUT | Cash index | Yes (60/40) | 5 | 5 |
| NDX | Cash index | Yes (60/40) | 25 | 25 |
| TLT | Long-bond ETF | No | 1 | 1 |
| GLD | Gold ETF | No | 1 | 1 |

### Entry construction

- Defined-risk iron condor (short put credit + short call credit, both wings protected)
- Short put delta target: −0.16 (one-sigma OTM)
- Short call delta target: +0.16 (symmetric)
- DTE at entry: 30 to 45 calendar days; selected expiry closest to 35 DTE
- Entry frequency: weekly Monday open per instrument
- One structure per name per week (no overlapping spreads in same instrument)

### Exit logic — five fates per side

Each side of the iron condor (put leg + call leg) is managed independently with its own `Trade` object, sharing an `iron_condor_id`:

| Fate | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `profit_target` | Per-side debit ≤ 50% of side's entry credit |
| `stop_loss` | Per-side debit ≥ 200% of side's entry credit (gap-aware fill) |
| `time_exit` | DTE ≤ 21 (per side) |
| `emergency` | \|short_delta\| > 0.50 (per side) |
| `eos_force` | End-of-OOS forced close |

Because per-side management is independent, one wing can hit profit-target while the other simultaneously hits emergency or stop-loss. This is the empirical observation: out of ~370 SPX iron condor structures over 2018–2024, **164 IC pairs had different fates between the two sides** and **175 had different close dates** — confirming the two-sided machinery operates as designed.

## Halt framework — 5 layers

| Layer | What it does | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Layer 1** Hard tail-event | Halt on VIX +50%/d, VVIX > 150, HYG-LQD > 3 SD | Active |
| Layer 2 Soft halt | Dropped post-v1 audit (-9.0pp lift, $413 of profitable trades blocked) | Removed |
| Layer 3 Slow halt | Dropped post-v1 audit (-10.1pp lift, $1,233 of profitable trades blocked) | Removed |
| **Layer 4** Drawdown halt | Halt on >90 days underwater OR >15% drawdown — **in trailing 90 days** (post-2026-05-03 spec-text alignment fix) | Active |
| **Layer 5** Auto-resume | Lift halt when 3 market-regime conditions clear simultaneously OR 60-day time fallback fires | Active |

Layer 5 (auto-resume) was originally designed with four conditions including a strategy-state-dependent drawdown-recovery condition. That created a catch-22 (halted strategy can't recover P&L → DD condition never satisfies → halt latches forever). The fix: drop the strategy-state condition, keep only 3 market-regime conditions, add a 60-trading-day time fallback. Methodology amendment §4.1 in the pre-commit doc.

Layer 4 had the same catch-22 in its original form. The fix: switch to trailing-90-day reference for both `underwater_days` and `drawdown_frac` (matching the spec text "in trailing 90 days"). Bug-fix-of-implementation, not a methodology amendment.

After both fixes: SPX halts_only OOS produced **12 distinct halt periods (max 92 days)** instead of the broken **single 673-day latch period**. Halts now resolve correctly.

## ML stack — 3 calibrated heads

All heads use XGBoost with **calibration auto-selected** per Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005) sample-size threshold: Platt scaling for n < 200 minority-class cases, isotonic for n ≥ 200. Class imbalance handled via `scale_pos_weight = neg/pos` per fold.

### Head 1 — trade quality (per-instrument)

- **Target:** binary `pnl_per_spread > 0` over the realized holding window
- **Output:** calibrated `p_quality ∈ [0,1]`
- **Sizing curve (continuous):**
  - p < 0.50 → skip trade
  - p ∈ [0.50, 0.70] → linearly scale 0.6× → 1.0× of base size
  - p ≥ 0.70 → 1.2× (capped)
- **Acceptance:** must beat majority-class baseline OOS log-loss on ≥ 3 of 5 instruments. Failure on ≥ 3 → drop entire Head 1, fall back to base sizing. Negative finding reported as such.

### Head 2 — regime stress (pooled cross-asset)

- **Target:** binary "stress event peak in next 63 trading days" sourced from 5 vetted historical peaks (Aug2015 China, Feb2018 Volmageddon, Q4-2018 selloff, Mar2020 COVID, Mar2023 banking)
- **Forward horizon:** 63 trading days = one quarter, anchored to BTZ 2009 §3 empirical R²-maximum at quarterly horizon
- **Output:** calibrated `p_stress ∈ [0,1]`
- **Book scaler:** aggregate book = base × (1 − p_stress)
- **Acceptance:** OOS Brier ≥ 5% lower than naive trailing-22-day stress-event mean baseline. Failure → drop, scaler defaults to 1.0.
- **Result:** **PASSED at +14.1% Brier reduction** (Brier 0.1079 vs naive 0.1256). Calibration auto-selected Platt for 5 of 7 folds, isotonic for 2.

### Head 3 — skew direction (per-instrument)

- **Target:** binary "did put-side or call-side incur larger loss in this iron condor?"
- **Output:** dynamic delta selection from {0.10, 0.16, 0.25} per side, replacing static 0.16/0.16
- **Acceptance:** must beat majority-class baseline OOS log-loss on ≥ 4 of 5 instruments. Per-instrument failure → fall back to static 0.16/0.16 for that instrument.

## Capital allocation across 5 instruments

- **Per-instrument weight (Phase B-1, equal-weight):** w_i = 1/5 each
- **Per-instrument weight (Phase B-2, quality-weighted):** w_i = p_quality_i / Σ_j p_quality_j
- **Aggregate book scaler:** book = base × (1 − p_stress) per Head 2
- **Per-trade hard cap:** 1% of account equity per spread (defined-risk = max-loss bounded)

Combined sizing formula:
```
size_i = base_size × w_i × (1 − p_stress) × continuous_quality(p_quality_i)
```

## Friction model

| Item | Spec |
|---|---|
| Slippage | 30/50/75/100% of bid-ask half-spread for VIX buckets <20 / 20–30 / 30–40 / >40 |
| Commissions | $0.65 per option contract per side |
| Gap-aware fill | Stop-loss fill = min(stop_level, opening_gap_price) |
| Monday gap rule | Gap ≥ 1.5% adds 50% slippage; gap ≥ 3% skips entry |
| Tax overlay (1256) | SPX/RUT/NDX: 60% LTCG / 40% STCG mark-to-market annually |
| Tax overlay (non-1256) | TLT/GLD: full ST treatment of options gains |

## Wheel basket — 5-layer adaptive logic

(See [Pre-commitments](pre_commitments.qmd#wheel) for full detail. Summary:)

- **Layer 1:** regime-conditional delta (VIX bottom Q → 0.15, mid → 0.20, top → 0.25)
- **Layer 2:** per-name vol-adjusted strikes (RV>35% widen by +0.05)
- **Layer 3:** per-name 30-day RV forecaster (XGBoost on HAR-RV + exogenous, sizing = clip(target_rv/forecast, 0.4, 1.5))
- **Layer 4:** earnings-aware management (7-day blackout pre-earnings, narrow CCs)
- **Layer 5:** fundamental-only defensive rolls (entry premise broken, not generic delta-threshold)

9-name basket: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, JNJ, KO, PG, WMT, JPM, PEP. Robustness baskets: 7-name strict (drops JPM, PEP), 8-name (adds JPM only).
